sentences.text:
Between:
Smt. Musti Manemma.
 ...Petitioner
And
The State of Telangana, Revenue Department and three others.

...Respondents ORDER:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri.Somu Srinivas Reddy, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 4.

With their consent,
the writ petition is being taken up for disposal at the admission stage itself.

2. This writ petition has being filed seeking the following prayer:-
"to declare the action of the respondent authorities more particularly 3rd respondent not considering representation dt 20.02.2026 for pay compensation/benefits under consent award in favour of petitioner in respect of the Land in Sy No.3AA/1, an extent Ac.0-10gts and Sy No.4A, an extent Ac.2-29 gts total an extent of Ac.2-39gts,
of Gadimunkanpally Village, Damargidda Mandal, Narayanpet Dist., under land acquisition for Narayanpet-Kodangal Lift Irrigation Scheme (NKLIS) as being illegal,
arbitrary, unconstitutional and violative of Articles 21 and 300A of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the 3rd respondent to consider representation dt 20.02.026 for pay compensation/benefits under consent award in favour of petitioner in respect of the Land in Sy No.3AA/1, an extent Ac.0-10gts and Sy No.4A,
an extent Ac.2-29gts total an extent of Ac.2-39gts, of Gadimunkanpally Village,
Damargidda Mandal, Narayanpet Dist., under land acquisition for Narayanpet- Kodangal Lift Irrigation Scheme (NKLIS)."
3.

The learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 4 placed on record instructions issued by the respondent No.3, wherein it is submitted that the Executive Engineer, I&CAD, Irrigation Division No.7, Makthal vide letter bearing Lr.No.EE/ID- 7/DB/NKLI/LA Proposals/99 dated 04.06.2025, submitted the requisition proposals for acquiring land admeasuring to an extent of Ac.792.04 gts at Damargidda Mandal of Narayanpet District for the purpose of Narayanpet- Kodangal Lift Irrigation Scheme (NKLIS).

Thereafter, Preliminary notification under Section 11(1) of the RFCTLA R&R Act 30 of 2013 was issued and the same was approved by the respondent No.2 and Gazette Nos.96 and 120 of 2025 were published.

Subsequently, on 07.11.2025, the Gramasabha at Gadimunkanpally village was conducted and petitioner has given objection petition stating that his brother Sri.Musti Chandrappa is having patta Musti Manemma vs The State Of Telangana on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79064161/
1 lands in subject survey numbers and further submitted that her brother expired leaving behind his 2 wives and 1 son and requested to pay the compensation amount to her.

sentences.text: Thereafter, notice was issued to the concerned and during the enquiry/hearing conducted on 07.02.2026, the legal heirs of Sri.Musti Chandrappa (notified person) did not accepted to pay the compensation amount to the petitioner.

It is further submitted that the notification is at preliminary stage and no compensation is paid to any land owner so far and appropriate action will be taken at the time of passing the award as per rules and if any dispute is arise, the land compensation amount will be deposited before the Authority under Section 77(2) of the LAAR Act 2013.

4. Recording the above submission and having considered the fact that the notification is at preliminary stage and compensation amount is not paid to any land owners, this writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent authorities to take appropriate action to the extent of claims made by the petitioner and after giving fair opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and the parties who have interest over the subject property, shall pass appropriate orders in accordance with law and communicate the same to the petitioner.

It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case and it is for the respondent authorities to pass appropriate orders strictly in accordance with law.
5.
With the above directions, this writ petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.

__ N. V. SHRAVAN KUMAR, J Dated: 06.03.2026 Su Musti Manemma vs The State Of Telangana on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79064161/
